visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-definition title screen featuring a close-up of the Z Gundam's head. Bold white text overlays read 'METAL BUILD Z GUNDAM' and '変形' (Transformation). The robot has white, blue, and red armor with yellow vents and a complex V-fin antenna. The background is a solid deep purple with professional studio lighting. (2) A pair of human hands enters the frame to begin the transformation. The camera uses an extreme close-up as the person flips the yellow vents and adjusts the head unit. The hands move with precision, sliding panels on the blue shoulder armor and revealing internal silver mechanical components. (3) The demonstration continues with the torso and waist sections. The hands pull the chest plate forward and fold the arms into the body cavity. Each movement is deliberate, showcasing the intricate joints and moving parts of the high-end metal-and-plastic model kit against a soft gradient backdrop. (4) The legs are transformed next, with the hands rotating the knee joints and folding the white shin guards over the feet. The large red and black wing binders are then manipulated, swinging out and locking into position to form the aerodynamic silhouette of the flight mode. (5) The final sequence shows the completed 'Wave Rider' mode. The model is mounted on a clear stand, appearing as a sleek spacecraft with a pointed nose and wide wings. Text overlays 'WAVE RIDER' and 'METAL BUILD Z GUNDAM' appear as the camera pans around the finished form.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a driving, high-tempo electronic synthesizer loop featuring a punchy 4-on-the-floor kick drum. There are no vocals. The spectral brightness is high, giving the track a modern, technical energy. (2) A sharp mechanical 'click' SFX triggers immediately as the hands move the first part of the robot. This sound is high-frequency and crisp, indicating a precise latching mechanism. The BGM maintains its steady rhythmic pulse in the background. (3) Each subsequent visual cut is accompanied by a unique percussive sound effect—snaps, clicks, and metallic slides. These sound effects are layered prominently over the music, creating a rhythmic synergy between the mechanical action and the soundtrack. (4) As the larger wing sections are deployed, the SFX shifts to a deeper, more resonant 'thud' and 'clack'. The music continues with a consistent intensity, devoid of pauses or dramatic shifts in tempo, providing a high-energy backdrop for the entire transformation sequence. (5) The video concludes with a final resonant clicking sound as the rifle is attached. The electronic music track sustain its final chord before a sharp cut to silence, leaving a clean and professional acoustic impression.

The fast-paced editing and synchronized foley sound effects emphasize the high-quality engineering and tactile satisfaction of the product.
